d:
A comic made by the Gentle Giant. Written around the premise of trying to figure out just how a draconic sorcerer can possibly be made. In this case exploring it through watersports.

Loosely based in D&D and the planescape setting.

An additional 4 new pages can be found on her Patreon and Substar.
